title: Get started with zuroar
text: roar() takes whole numbers order, without duplicates. roar_range() takes ends range, included seq(), roar_add() roar_remove() return changed copy.
code: x <- roar(c(1L, 5L, 9L, 100000L)) x <- roar_add(x, 7L) x <- roar_remove(x, 5L) y <- roar_range(1, 1e6) y <- roar_remove(y, from = 10, to = 19)

title: Get started with zuroar
text: roar_contains() fast membership test. Ranges inclusive, roar_rank() counts values one, roar_select() finds k-th smallest, roar_next() nearest value .
code: roar_contains(x, c(5L, 6L)) #> [1] FALSE FALSE roar_count(y, from = 10, to = 20) #> [1] 1 roar_rank(x, 9L) #> [1] 3 roar_select(x, c(1, 2)) #> [1] 1 7 roar_next(x, 8L) #> [1] 9

title: Get started with zuroar
text: bitmaps, | union, & intersection <= subset test. Counts similarities need intermediate bitmap.
code: x | y x & y x <= y roar_cardinality(x, y, op = "and") roar_jaccard(x, y)

title: Get started with zuroar
